Final for Publication
APPLICATION 23060-T1

SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1
ZONING AMENDMENT
PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
3440-3444 North Janssen

The Applicant seeks to rezone 3440-3444 North Janssen from an RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse to divide the
zoning lot and construct an addition to the existing detached house at 3440 North Janssen.
Currently, 3440 North Janssen is improved with a detached house having a height of 25’9” and
with a rear accessory coach house with a three-car garage. The Applicant is proposing a rear
addition to the detached house. 3444 North Janssen is improved with a residential building
containing three dwelling units with a height of 36 feet and no parking spaces. No changes are
being proposed to the existing three-flat at 3444 North Janssen. No commercial space will be
provided. Following construction of the addition to the detached house at 3440 North Janssen,
the Applicant will apply to rezone the parcel back to the current RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

The Applicant requires relief for the detached house at the 3440 North Janssen. Pursuant to
Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks a variation to reduce the combined side setback to 5.59
feet and to reduce the rear setback to 0 feet pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-B. The applicant seeks
an administrative adjustment to reduce the rear yard open space to 270 square feet pursuant to
Section 17-13-1003-K. The Applicant seeks all relief as needed, as allowed by the Zoning
Ordinance, for the attached plans.
